SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Project, part of Tool and Production. Driving tools (8 lesson) By the end of the Sub Strand, the  in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9 PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How do we solve the challenges in day-to-day life using the skills learnt in this study area?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Project together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: A learner acquires effective communication skills when discussing possible items that can be made to solve the problem.

• Communication and collaboration: A learner develops speaking and listening skills when brainstorming on the problem in the locality that

can be solved using the skills acquired.

• Critical thinking and problem solving: A learner develops evaluation and decision making skills when selecting an item that can be made

using the skills acquired.

Values:
• Responsibility: A learner cares for tools and materials when making the item.

• Respect: A learner appreciates diverse opinions of others as they discuss possible items that can be made to solve the identified problem.

32

Link to other Learning Area:

• Mathematics: A learner carries out the works to specified measurements.

• Integrated Science: A learner observes safety when working on the project.

Suggested Learning Resources:

• Digital Portfolio.

• Digital devices with assistive technology.

• Camera.

• Resource person.

• Print and Braille Pre-Technical Studies textbooks.
